crossRefs.note: Men shall go into the caves of the rocks, and into the holes of the earth, from before the terror of Yahweh, and from…
to go into the caverns of the rocks, and into the clefts of the ragged rocks, from before the terror of Yahweh, and…
Therefore Yahweh brought on them the captains of the army of the king of Assyria, who took Manasseh in chains, bound…
“Behold, I will send for many fishermen,” says Yahweh, “and they will fish them up. Afterward I will send for many…
They will lick the dust like a serpent. Like crawling things of the earth they shall come trembling out of their dens.…

translations.web: They shall come, and shall all rest in the desolate valleys, in the clefts of the rocks, on all thorn hedges, and on all pastures.
translations.bsb: And they will all come and settle in the steep ravines and clefts of the rocks, in all the thornbushes and watering holes.
translations.kjv: And they shall come, and shall rest all of them in the desolate valleys, and in the holes of the rocks, and upon all thorns, and upon all bushes.
translations.asv: And they shall come, and shall rest all of them in the desolate valleys, and in the clefts of the rocks, and upon all thorn-hedges, and upon all pastures.
